descriptionHtml:
Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15IRH10 Business Laptop (Intel Core i7-13620H / 16GB / 512GB SSD) Luna Grey Layout

Streamline your daily multitasking, study, and professional business workflows with the sleek Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15IRH10 laptop, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Powering this reliable notebook is the high-performance Intel Core i7-13620H processor, coupled with 16GB of system memory and a fast 512GB NVMe PCIe SSD for snappy response times and ample storage capacity. Visuals look remarkably crisp and spacious on the modern 15.3-inch WUXGA display profile. Styled in a sophisticated Luna Grey finish, this dynamic laptop provides reliable portability with a robust 3-cell 50Wh battery configuration. Exclusive bundle offer: comes complete with an original Lenovo carrying bag and an original Lenovo mouse inside the setup. This retail bundle is fully backed by a 2-year official agency warranty setup.
